summary: Aermotor steel lookout on Bald Eagle Ridge near State College; a tower built in the 1930s was moved here in 1985 and renamed Eagle Field.

facts.design: Aermotor steel tower with 7x7 cab and rooftop catwalk

access.note: On a privately owned airstrip (Eagle Field, 09PA). Ask the owner before visiting; no public visiting information found.

events.note: Original tower at the Elliott Tower site in Jefferson County, per the former-sites register. The storymap gives 1930 and the register says the 1930s.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives the 1930s near Reynoldsburg as Elliot Tower; the storymap gives 1930; the former-sites register gives 1931 at the Elliott Tower site, moved in 1985. Read as one tower that moved to Eagle Field. The year and the original site are not settled.

sources.title: Fire Towers of Pennsylvania (StoryMap data, Shawn Lesitsky)
Eagle Field Airport (09PA), Port Matilda, Pennsylvania

notes_for_editor: Build year and first site are disputed: register says 1930s near Reynoldsburg as Elliot Tower; storymap says 1930; former-sites register says 1931 at the Elliott Tower site (Jefferson County), moved 1985. The move rests on the former-sites register alone. No dated source confirms current condition. Access is inferred from private airstrip ownership (City-Data); no visiting information found. The record's built 1930 (from the storymap) is left unchanged, so a human should reconcile it with the 1931 event. The register's 'near Reynoldsburg' is unexplained; a Reynoldsville in Jefferson County would fit the former-sites register, but nothing checked confirms that.
